# 9takes Brand Kit

**Updated:** 2026-11-06
**Live page:** https://9takes.com/admin/brand (admin only; same content plus a card studio)
**Source data:** `src/lib/brand/brandKit.ts`, `brandTokens.ts`, `brandCardPresets.ts`

Read this before writing copy, building a page, auditing messaging or making social assets.
Wording disputes: `docs/brand/messaging-hierarchy.md` wins. Visual disputes: `docs/brand/cold-light.md` wins.

## Hard rules for agents

- **Never generate images** (no OpenRouter, Gemini, Canva AI, OpenAI images, or driving ChatGPT). Render brand cards with `pnpm brand:card`, or write a statue prompt (below) and hand it to DJ.
- Never show what a take says before someone answers: not in previews, share cards, emails or posts.
- No amber, orange or warm light. Dark only.
- Anton lines are uppercase, 2 to 5 words, never a full sentence. Pair them with a Playfair italic quiet line.
- About one mint element per view: the action.

## Making assets

```bash
pnpm brand:card -- --list                       # presets, templates, formats, statues
pnpm brand:card -- --preset ig-formula --out out.png
pnpm brand:card -- --template statement --format ig-post --kicker "Today's question" \
  --headline "Answer before the crowd" --voice "Nine takes are waiting." --statue smirk --out card.png
pnpm brand:card -- --template question --format x-post --question "..." --out q.png
pnpm brand:card -- --template slide --format ig-post --index "03 / 07" --headline "..." --body "..." --out s3.png
pnpm brand:card -- --template person --name "Adam Sandler" --type 9 --portrait /types/9s/Adam-Sandler.webp --out p.png
pnpm gen:brand-og                               # re-render every site link preview after a copy change
```

Templates: **statement** (loud + quiet line, statue or nine masks), **question** (question text, nine closed takes, mint action), **person** (portrait, name, type), **slide** (carousel body).

| `ig-post`  | 1080×1350 | Instagram post / carousel slide (4:5) |
| `ig-story` | 1080×1920 | Instagram Story / Reel cover (9:16)   |

## The message hierarchy (locked)

| Level               | Line                                                                | Job                                          | Use in                                                          |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Movement belief     | **The internet collapses nine perspectives into one winning take.** | Names the problem in the world.              | Manifestos, founder posts, podcasts, category essays.           |
| Brand promise       | **See the emotions behind every take.**                             | What a person gains from 9takes.             | Bios, page furniture, social profiles, closing lines.           |
| Product ritual      | **Answer before the crowd.**                                        | The behavior that makes 9takes different.    | Calls to action and product demos.                              |
| Product explanation | **One question, nine perspectives.**                                | The product in the fewest words.             | Fast descriptions, homepage, outreach.                          |
| Personal payoff     | **Stop mistaking someone else’s alarm for a defect.**               | Makes the benefit personal.                  | Stories about conflict, relationships, blind spots.             |
| Core formula        | **Honesty + Curiosity = Clarity.**                                  | The three steps of every question, in order. | How-it-works in one breath: about, onboarding, bios, this page. |

**Main narrative:** We each experience our own emotional alarm as reality. Another person’s alarm can look irrational, obstructive, weak, or aggressive from the outside. Online, the crowd hardens that mistake: one interpretation wins the room and the rest disappear. 9takes opens the room again. You answer before the crowd can shape you, then compare nine perspectives on the same question and see the emotions underneath each one.

**On-message test.** A reader can answer all four:

1. What is wrong with the current environment? One interpretation wins and hides the rest.
2. What does 9takes do differently? You answer before seeing the crowd, then nine perspectives open up.
3. Why does that matter personally? It exposes blind spots and the emotional logic other people are using.
4. What should I do next? Answer one real question.

## Voice

| Trait                       | Means                                      | Example                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tactically direct           | No fluff. Say the useful thing.            | Type 6s signal loyalty through questions. Answer them; don’t get defensive. |
| Socially savvy              | Tie the insight to a real-world win.       | Type 8s respect directness. Type 9s need a gentler way in.                  |
| Respectfully provocative    | Push on comfort zones. Honest, never mean. | If your friends always agree with you, you’re missing intel.                |
| Pattern-recognition focused | Show the emotional logic.                  | She’s not being difficult. Type 1s need it done right the first time.       |
| Results-driven              | End on something to try.                   | Try this tonight and watch the dynamic shift.                               |

- Lead with the human situation; the Enneagram is the map, not the hero. (IG captions may open type-first.)
- Rhythm: hook, insight, action step.
- Verbs we like: decode, navigate, map, read, unlock, resolve.
- Hedge typing of real people: "my read", never a diagnosis. Disclaimer: "Speculative personality read based on publicly available behavior, not diagnosis."
- No politics, no diagnosis, no cruelty.
- Never quote what a take says before someone answers: not in previews, share cards, emails or posts.

| `fear`     | `static/brand/statues/fear.webp`     | Fear (head triad: 5, 6, 7)   | fear                           |
| `shame`    | `static/brand/statues/shame.webp`    | Shame (heart triad: 2, 3, 4) | shame                          |
| `dialogue` | `static/brand/statues/dialogue.webp` | Two philosophers in dialogue | one conversation, two readings |

- Statues only. No photos of people, places or phones as brand imagery.
- Dry, matte, weathered marble with blank carved eyes. One light from the upper left on black.
- Restrained expressions, like real sculpture. No text inside the image.
- Every statue gets the same indigo tint ramp after generation. Never hand-tint or recolor per type.
- Agents never generate images. They write the prompt; DJ runs it in ChatGPT on his subscription.

**Prompt template for a new statue** (hand to DJ; he runs it in ChatGPT):

> A classical Greek marble statue, [SUBJECT AND POSE: e.g. a young woman covering her mouth, eyes wide, mid-gasp], carved in dry, matte, weathered grey marble with visible pores and chips. Blank carved eyes with no pupils. Restrained, sculptural expression, not theatrical. Lit by a single soft light from the upper left, deep shadows falling to the lower right. Pure black background. Neutral grey stone only: no color, no tint, no warm light, no glow. No text, no lettering, no frame. Photographed like a museum sculpture, [CROP: head and shoulders / waist up / two figures], portrait orientation 4:5.

Then tint it: `node scripts/cold-light-tint.mjs <grey-image> static/brand/statues/<name>.webp --max-width 1200` and add it to `STATUES` in `src/lib/brand/brandTokens.ts`.

## Instagram

**Bio** (Proposed. No current IG bio is saved in the repo; paste what is live here when it changes.)

```
9takes · Enneagram & Personality
See the emotions behind every take.
One question, nine perspectives.
Answer before the crowd ↓
```

Link in bio goes to a live question page, not a blog post.

| What                       | Size                           | Note                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Feed post / carousel slide | 1080×1350 (4:5)                | Profile grid crops to 3:4, so keep text 40px+ from the left and right edges. Brand cards already do. |
| Story / Reel cover         | 1080×1920 (9:16)               | Keep text out of the top 250px and bottom 340px (IG UI).                                             |
| Profile photo              | 320×320 shown as a circle      | Use the nine-mask mark on Night (512 PNG).                                                           |
| Highlight cover            | 1080×1920, center 600px circle | Mark or one Anton word on Night.                                                                     |

| Format                  | Detail                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Story / person deck     | 9 to 11 slides. Cover, 5 to 7 tidbits (≤115 chars), story slides, type reveal, mirror slide with no CTA. |
| Teaching deck           | 9 to 13 slides. One idea per slide. Caption 90 to 160 words.                                             |
| Lookup deck             | 15 to 20 slides: one per type or per person, built to be saved.                                          |
| Checklist               | 7 slides.                                                                                                |
| Manifesto               | 8 slides built on the movement belief.                                                                   |
| Reel                    | 26 seconds default, about 52 voiceover words. On-screen text never repeats the voiceover. No CTA card.   |
| One Take (DJ on camera) | Six beats, 85 to 90 seconds plus a 45-second cut. Open on a verified quote.                              |

- One bright slide per deck. Never two diagram slides in a row.
- Captions: person posts may open type-first in the type’s own vernacular, then the person as proof, then "Are you a Type N? Tag one."
- CTA is participation ("comment your number"), not "link in bio" on every post. Blog link goes in the pinned comment.
- Never show a take’s text before someone answers. Show counts, types and blurred rows instead.

Commands: `/moodboard → /carousel`, `/distribute-instagram`, `/instagram-saves`, `/one-take`

## X

**Bio.** Live bio (2026-05-19) still sells "why you’re stuck". Proposed rewrite below follows the hierarchy.

- Live: Why you’re stuck explained by your Enneagram type. 300+ deep dives on the 9 ways people think. Your type’s patterns. Your type’s fix. Find yours
- Proposed: One question, nine perspectives. Answer before the crowd, then see the emotions behind every take. Enneagram reads on 460+ famous people ↓

| What          | Size            | Note                                                                         |
| ------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Post image    | 1600×900 (16:9) | Also fine: 1080×1350 portrait.                                               |
| Header        | 1500×500 (3:1)  | Profile photo covers the bottom-left; the brand card keeps text right of it. |
| Profile photo | 400×400         | Nine-mask mark on Night.                                                     |
| Link card     | 1200×630        | Pulled from each page’s og:image (the link previews below).                  |

Post formats: "According to psychology…", "My therapist told me…", "How to deal with…", One-liner, "Just heal your X", Pop-culture typing, "Reply with your type"

- No link in the main post. Put it in the first reply.
- #enneagram never leads a post.
- At most one em dash.
- No "doing a series on…".
- Single posts 71 to 100 characters land best; threads 4 to 8 posts.
- Post 9 to 10 AM ET; threads at 8 PM. Reply to everything in the first hour.

Commands: `/twitter-post`, `/twitter`, `/tweet-reply`, `/twitter-warmup`

## Rules

**Always**

- Dark only. Night background, never pure black.
- Show that takes exist before someone answers: counts, types, blurred rows.
- About one mint element per view: the action.
- Pair the loud line with the quiet one: Anton, then Playfair italic.
- Corners: 4px (badges), 10px (buttons, inputs), 16px (cards), full (pills).
- Statues get the shared tint ramp.

**Never**

- Show what a take says before someone answers, anywhere.
- Amber, orange or warm light. Including old templates.
- Indigo as text or focus outlines.
- A fourth typeface, or Anton in a full sentence.
- Hacker clichés: code rain, glitch text, skulls.
- Cruelty. Honest, never mean.
- AI-generated images by agents. Write the prompt; DJ runs it.
